reason_words.scope_or_structure: an answer to some of these questions would change what the story covers or how the test plan is built, so the factory cannot go on by guessing
reason_words.no_readings: for some of these questions the factory could not name even two possible answers, so it cannot offer you a choice and needs your own words
reason_words.dependent: the answer to one of these questions changes another, so they have to be settled together
reason_words.over_threshold: too much of the story rests on questions nobody has answered yet
reason_words.low_confidence: the factory is not confident enough in its reading of the story to go on without you
reason_words.blocking: some of these questions are marked as blocking: the plan or the cases written next depend on their answers, so that work waits for them
